lines.t: Built on Mount Moriah on the threshing-floor of Ornan or Araunah

Anxious to build
Being a man of war not permitted to build

lines.t: Made preparations for building
Charged Solomon to build
Prayed that Solomon might have wisdom to build
lines.ru: Молился, чтобы Соломон получил мудрость для его строительства

Free will offering of the people for the building

Determined to build
Specially instructed for

lines.t: Built without the noise of hammers, axe, or any tool

The sanctuary or greater house
The oracle or most holy place
The porch
Surrounded with three stories of chambers communicating with the interior on the right side

lines.t: Surrounded with spacious courts

Was roofed with cedar

Had folding doors of fir wood carved and golden

lines.t: The oracle or most holy place
Was twenty cubits every way
Two cherubims of gilded olive wood made within

lines.t: Cedar of, carved with flowers, &c

lines.t: Ceiled with fir wood and gilt
The whole inside and outside covered with gold

lines.t: Garnished with precious stones
The porch of

Its magnificence
Was seven years in building

lines.ru: Окончен в восьмой месяц одиннадцатого года Соломона

The house of the Lord
The mountain of the Lord’s house

Zion
Mount Zion
